primary_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL primary instance

primary_port.description: Port number of the PostgreSQL primary instance

primary_user.description: Username with replication privileges on the primary

primary_password.description: Password for the primary user (recommended: use .pgpass or scram-sha-256 auth)

primary_database.description: Database to connect to on the primary (used for slot queries)

standby_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL standby instance

standby_port.description: Port number of the PostgreSQL standby instance

standby_user.description: Username with replication privileges on the standby

standby_database.description: Database to connect to on the standby

name.description: Name of the logical replication slot

two_phase.description: Enable two-phase commit support for this slot

replication_slots.description: List of logical replication slots to manage for high availability

check_interval.description: Seconds between health checks and slot synchronization attempts

auto_promote.description: If true, automatically promote slots to the new primary during failover

strict_mode.description: If true, abort operation on any slot sync error (fail-fast)

operation_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for replication operations (slot creation, sync, etc.)
